reason: The opossum ATAC data was mapped to a sharded monDom5 reference: chromosome 1 is split into chr1+chr1b and chromosome 2 into chr2+chr2b. Evidence: opossum peaks on chr1 stop at 536005325 while monDom5 chr1 is 748055161 bp, peaks on chr2 stop at 536123645 while chr2 is 541556283 bp, and 536141479+211913682=748055161 and 536141008+5415275=541556283 exactly. Neither UCSC nor NCBI distributes chr1b/chr2b for monDom5 and the shard boundary cannot be recovered to the base from peak coordinates alone (136 kb of admissible slack), so the contigs are deliberately not reconstructed.
mitigation: Sequence-based evidence for opossum is restricted to the 93.87% of peaks whose contig is present in the reference; every downstream table records that restriction. Raw chromVAR for opossum is computed on the peaks with a recovered sequence.
